title: DifFRACT: Diffusion Feature Reconstruction and Attribution for Circuit Tracing
abstract: arXiv:2606.15796v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While transcoder-based circuit tracing has recently enabled detailed causal analyses of large language models, it remains unclear how semantic information propagates across denoising steps and how text and image representations interact within multimodal diffusion transformers (MM-DiT) for image generation. Attention maps expose only a limited view of token interactions, and sparse autoencoders find interpretable features but do not reveal how nonlinear MLP layers transform and compose them. In this work, we extend transcoder-based circuit tracing to multimodal diffusion transformers. We train timestep-conditioned transcoders that faithfully approximate the input-output behavior of the MLP sublayers in the double-stream blocks of FLUX.1[schnell]. translated_title: DifFRACT：用于电路追踪的扩散特征重建与归因
translated_abstract: 虽然基于转码器的电路追踪最近使对大语言模型进行详细因果分析成为可能，但语义信息如何在去噪步骤之间传播，以及文本和图像表示如何在多模态扩散变换器（MM-DiT）中相互作用以进行图像生成，目前仍不清楚。注意力图只能提供词元相互作用的有限视角，而稀疏自编码器虽然能找到可解释的特征，却无法揭示非线性MLP层如何变换和组合这些特征。在这项工作中，我们将基于转码器的电路追踪方法扩展到了多模态扩散变换器。我们训练了以时间步为条件的转码器，忠实地逼近FLUX.1[schnell]双流块中MLP子层的输入输出行为。通过用转码器替换MLP并对其余计算进行线性化，我们获得了精确的特征到特征归因，并在可解释特征之上构建了紧凑的归因图。
tldr: 本文提出DifFRACT方法，首次将基于转码器的电路追踪技术扩展到多模态扩散变换器，通过训练时间步条件化的转码器替换FLUX.1中的MLP子层，实现了对图像生成模型内部可解释特征的精确归因和电路分析。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DifFRACT, which extends transcoder-based circuit tracing to multimodal diffusion transformers for the first time, enabling exact feature-to-feature attribution and interpretable circuit analysis of image generation models by training timestep-conditioned transcoders to replace MLP sublayers in FLUX.1[schnell].
